desc: Speer Ammunition, a key player in the industry for decades, brings innovation and reliability to its products. The Gold Dot LE Duty series was developed to meet the rigorous demands of law enforcement agencies worldwide. With a commitment to quality and performance, Speer has refined its hollow-point design to ensure consistent expansion and penetration in various conditions. The +P version of the Gold Dot ammunition offers increased pressure for enhanced velocity and energy, crucial for self-defense situations.
